title: Rivet agentOS technical manual exported as 825-page PDF book
summary: Rivet founder Nathan Flurry shares a PDF export of Rivet's hand-written docs as an 825-page technical manual covering actors, agentOS, workflows, dynamic apps, Rivet Cloud, and self-hosting — human docs plus agent skills maintained in parallel.
question_it_answers: What does Rivet's full agentOS documentation cover when exported as a single manual?

claims.text: Rivet's documentation was exported as an 825-page technical manual PDF.
claims.evidence: it's something else to see years of work as 825 pages in book form
claims.subject: agent-harness-loops

claims.text: The manual is publicly linked at assets.rivet.dev/manual/Rivet-Technical-Manual.pdf.
